name: Full pitch: diagnostic -> pain math -> summary -> offer
description: Tests complete pitch progression. OM opens people thread, reveals pain, gets summarized, coach must deliver Grand Slam Offer only AFTER 'that's right'. Validates no-skip-stages discipline.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: This is Karen, office manager at Bright Smiles.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Karen, Seb with DentaVoice. I work with Salt Lake practices on phone coverage. Would it be unreasonable if I took two minutes?

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: How's your front desk team doing with the workload?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We're down a person. Megan's been handling everything alone most days. It's been rough.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: People thread. Play 14 follow-up or Play 21 label.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: That's a lot on one person. When it gets hectic, what gives first — the phones?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Yeah, phones. Megan helps whoever's at the counter first. Phone just rings.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Gap question or pain math. Progression toward pitch.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: How many calls do you think go to voicemail on a busy day?

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Specific pain number disclosed. Should mirror or transition to pain math. Play 22 (people/chaos pain math) ideal.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Quick math with what you told me. If 10 calls a day hit voicemail during busy hours, conservatively 30% are new patients. At $800 each, that's $80,000-$100,000 a year walking out the door. And the hard part — you never see the ones you lost.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: God, when you put it like that.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: So let me make sure I'm hearing you right. You're down a person, Megan's handling everything, phones get missed when it's busy, patients have complained, and you know some are probably calling somewhere else. But hiring someone just for phones isn't in the budget.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: 'THAT'S EXACTLY IT' = that's right moment. MUST fire Play 25 (Grand Slam Offer). Anything else is a failure to close the loop after hard-earned buy-in.
